normal.coordinates: West-longitude labels run 180 to 0 to 180 from left to right. Convert to east-positive by wrapping the left edge at 180 E; no mirror.

enhanced.coordinates: West-longitude labels run 360 to 180 to 0 from left to right. East-positive longitude increases from 0 to 360; no mirror.
enhanced.processing: Published radiometric calibration, geographic registration, photometric correction, and mosaic assembly by Paul Schenk. No further photometric correction or blending applied here.

shape.rendering: Mean-radius sphere: deviates about +4.1% to -3.9% from these reference semiaxes. No claimed shape-model geometry or height displacement.

coverage: Both delivered products contain global imagery, including lower-resolution inserts. No validity masks or missing-value codes accompany these display images. Do not classify observed black shadows as gaps or invent missing terrain.

elevation.label: observations/mimas_radius_g.xml
elevation.coordinates: Planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude; use exact GeoTIFF origin and pixel spacing, without stretching the raster to 360 by 180 degrees.
elevation.coverage: All 2,468,642 raster cells are finite and valid. The geotransform covers less than the global bounding box advertised in the label; preserve the eastern and southern edge gaps.
elevation.processing: Bilinear interpolation within the measured raster only; 1x height scale and northwest cartographic relief. Source is 2222 by 1111 at 559.13 m, resampled to the shared 8192 by 4096 display layout without adding detail.
